title: Exhaust fans.
officialText:
Components of exhaust fans shall be rated and certified by the manufacturer for the probable temperature rise
to which the components will be exposed. This temperature rise shall be computed by:
T = (Q /mC) + (T ) (Equation 5-4)
s c a
where:
C = Specific heat of smoke at smoke-layer temperature, Btu/lb°F (kJ/kg × K).
m = Exhaust rate, pounds per second (kg/s).
Q = Convective heat output of fire, Btu/s (kW).
c
T = Ambient temperature, °F (K).
a
T = Smoke temperature, °F (K).
s
Exception: Reduced T as calculated based on assurance on inadequate dilution air.
s
